<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dirt Defense Detailing LLC | Premium Mobile Auto Detailing | Gallatin,
TN</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<!-- Google Fonts import for Bitter and Inter -->
<link
href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bitter:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400;1,70
0&family=Inter:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
--bg-color: #050608; /* Deep cool black showroom base */
--card-bg: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.45); /* Cool slate black container base */
--text-primary: #FFFFFF;
--text-secondary: #9CA3AF; /* Cool titanium gray */
--accent-color: #D1D5DB; /* Polished Titanium Silver */
--vivid-accent: #00F0FF; /* Luminous Electric Cyan (represents glass, water &
gloss) */
--border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); /* Transparent glass border */
--font-head: 'Bitter', serif;
--font-body: 'Inter', sans-serif;
--max-width: 1100px;
}
/* Reset & Base Styles */
* {
box-sizing: border-box;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
}
html, body {
overflow-x: hidden; /* Prevent horizontal page scaling or viewport shifts on touch
devices */
width: 100%;
}
body {
background-color: var(--bg-color);
background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #1A1D24 0%, #050608
100%);
color: var(--text-primary);
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-weight: 300; /* Light weight for luxury modern feel */
letter-spacing: 0.03em;
line-height: 1.7;
-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
padding-top: 85px; /* Offset to prevent content hiding behind fixed header on
desktop */
}
/* --- AMBIENT NEON-LIGHT BACKGLOWS --- */
body::before {
content: '';
position: fixed;
top: 15%;
left: 10%;
width: 350px;
height: 350px;
background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.09) 0%, transparent
70%);
z-index: -1;
pointer-events: none;
}
body::after {
content: '';
position: fixed;
bottom: 15%;
right: 15%;
width: 450px;
height: 450px;
background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(209, 213, 219, 0.06) 0%, transparent
70%);
z-index: -1;
pointer-events: none;
}
a {
color: inherit;
text-decoration: none;
}
h1, h2, h3, .logo, .header-phone {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic; /* Luxury serif italic branding style */
}
/* Ensure input, form elements, and buttons inherit the styling */
input, select, textarea, button, .btn {
font-style: italic;
}
/* Utilities */
.container {
max-width: var(--max-width);
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 0 2rem;
width: 100%;
}
/* Decorative Titanium Divider with Subtle Glow */
.titanium-divider {
width: 50px;
height: 1.5px;
background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-color), var(--vivid-accent));
box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.5);
margin: 1.5rem 0 0 0;
border: none;
}
.gold-divider.center {
margin: 1.5rem auto 0 auto;
}
/* Review Star Treatment with Luminous Neon Pulse */
.stars {
color: var(--vivid-accent);
text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.6);
font-size: 0.85rem;
letter-spacing: 3px;
margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
/* Category Tagging */
.category-tag {
display: block;
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.75rem;
font-weight: 400;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.25em;
color: var(--accent-color);
margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
/* Slower Scroll Reveal Animation Styles */
.reveal {
opacity: 0;
filter: brightness(0.1); /* Starts almost entirely dark */
transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.99);
/* 1.5s for a slow, premium fade */
transition:
opacity 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
filter 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.reveal.active {
opacity: 1;
filter: brightness(1); /* Transitions to full brightness */
transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
}
/* Staggered transition delays for grids */
.delay-100 { transition-delay: 100ms; }
.delay-200 { transition-delay: 200ms; }
.delay-300 { transition-delay: 300ms; }
.delay-400 { transition-delay: 400ms; }
.delay-500 { transition-delay: 500ms; }
/* Header (Always available on scroll using position: fixed) */
header {
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding: 1.25rem 0;
position: fixed; /* Fixed to the viewport to be globally and always clickable */
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
background-color: rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.94);
backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
z-index: 9999; /* Highest priority layer to prevent standard grid overlap */
box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
header .container {
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
align-items: center;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 1rem;
}
.logo {
font-size: 1.6rem;
font-weight: 600;
letter-spacing: -0.01em;
color: var(--text-primary);
}
/* Header Phone Click-to-Call styled with soft titanium underline */
.header-phone {
font-size: 1.25rem;
font-weight: 500;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--vivid-accent);
padding-bottom: 2px;
transition: color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
}
.header-phone:hover {
color: var(--vivid-accent);
border-color: var(--text-primary);
}
/* --- GLASSMORPHISM STYLING FOR CLICKABLE ITEMS & PANELS
(LUMINOUS) --- */
/* 1. Main Action Buttons (Frosted Glass with Hover Glow) */
.btn {
display: inline-block;
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
color: var(--text-primary);
border: 1px solid rgba(209, 213, 219, 0.25); /* Semi-transparent titanium border
*/
border-radius: 4px;
padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem;
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-weight: 700;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0,
0.3);
transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
cursor: pointer;
text-align: center;
}
.btn:hover {
background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15); /* Semi-transparent Electric Cyan */
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
color: var(--text-primary);
transform: translateY(-2px);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), 0 0 25px rgba(0, 240,
255, 0.35);
}
.btn:active {
transform: translateY(0);
}
/* 2. Header Tab Navigation Buttons (Pill-like Glass Capsules) */
.tab-navigation {
display: flex;
gap: 1.5rem;
}
.nav-link {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
border-radius: 30px;
color: var(--text-secondary);
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.85rem;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
cursor: pointer;
padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.nav-link.active, .nav-link:hover {
color: var(--text-primary);
background: rgba(209, 213, 219, 0.15);
border-color: var(--accent-color);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 0 15px rgba(209, 213,
219, 0.25);
}
/* 3. Portfolio Work Filter Buttons (Translucent Glass Tabs) */
.gallery-tabs {
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 1rem;
margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.tab-btn {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
color: var(--text-secondary);
padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem;
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.8rem;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
cursor: pointer;
backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.tab-btn.active, .tab-btn:hover {
background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
color: var(--text-primary);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255,
0.2);
}
/* 4. Dropdowns & Selects (Deep Frosted Glass) */
.calc-select {
width: 100%;
background-color: rgba(26, 29, 36, 0.55);
border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
color: var(--text-primary);
padding: 1.1rem;
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.95rem;
letter-spacing: 0.03em;
appearance: none;
background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg fill='white' height='24'
viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='24' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M7 10l5 5
5-5z'/><path d='M0 0h24v24H0z' fill='none'/></svg>");
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-position: right 1.1rem center;
background-size: 1.25rem;
cursor: pointer;
backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.calc-select:focus {
outline: none;
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
}
/* 5. Inputs & Textareas (Translucent Dark Charcoal Glass) */
.form-control {
width: 100%;
background-color: rgba(26, 29, 36, 0.4);
border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
color: var(--text-primary);
padding: 1.1rem;
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.95rem;
letter-spacing: 0.03em;
backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.form-control:focus {
outline: none;
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
}
/* 6. Structural Cards & Panels (Frosted Glass Sheets with Ambient Cyan Glows) */
.service-card, .pricing-card, .calculator-box, .contact-form, .info-block {
background: rgba(26, 29, 36, 0.45);
backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(120%);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(120%);
border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02),
0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
0 0 20px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.02); /* Soft internal light */
transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.service-card:hover, .pricing-card:hover, .calculator-box:hover {
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
transform: translateY(-5px);
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
0 15px 35px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12), /* Intense blue active glow */
0 0 25px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
}
/* --- THE LUXURIOUS TICKER FRAMEWORK (Viewport Edge-to-Edge) --- */
.marquee-frame-container {
position: relative;
width: 100%; /* Spans full page width, ending where the viewport ends */
margin: 3.5rem 0;
padding: 6px;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(209, 213, 219, 0.15), rgba(0, 240,
255, 0.03));
box-shadow: 0 12px 40px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
/* Ticker Base with Heavy Blur and Titanium Border */
.marquee-inner-frame {
position: relative;
border-top: 1px solid var(--accent-color);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--accent-color);
background: rgba(26, 29, 36, 0.55);
backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(120%);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(120%);
padding: 1.5rem 0;
overflow: hidden;
white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Ornate Corner Accents */
.marquee-corner {
position: absolute;
width: 12px;
height: 12px;
border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
z-index: 5;
}
.corner-tl { top: 2px; left: 2px; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; }
.corner-tr { top: 2px; right: 2px; border-left: none; border-bottom: none; }
.corner-bl { bottom: 2px; left: 2px; border-right: none; border-top: none; }
.corner-br { bottom: 2px; right: 2px; border-left: none; border-top: none; }
.marquee-wrapper {
display: flex;
width: max-content;
}
.marquee-content {
display: inline-block;
animation: scroll-left 25s linear infinite;
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
font-weight: 700;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-color), var(--vivid-accent));
-webkit-background-clip: text;
-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
padding-right: 2rem;
}
@keyframes scroll-left {
0% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
100% { transform: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0); }
}
/* Hero Section with Background Detailing Image */
.hero {
position: relative;
background-image: linear-gradient(
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.65),
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.8)
), url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1618843479313-
40f8afb4b4d8?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2400&q=95');
background-size: cover;
background-position: center;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-attachment: scroll; /* Tablet compatible scroll fallback */
min-height: 85vh;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding: 6rem 0;
}
.hero h1 {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 5.5rem);
line-height: 1.05;
letter-spacing: -0.02em;
margin-bottom: 2rem;
font-weight: 700;
}
.hero-desc {
font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.3rem);
color: var(--text-secondary);
max-width: 750px;
margin-bottom: 3rem;
font-weight: 300;
}
/* Brand Promise with Secondary Vivid Backdrop */
.promise {
position: relative;
background-image: linear-gradient(
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.88),
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.95)
), url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1549399542-
7e3f8b79c341?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2400&q=95');
background-size: cover;
background-position: center center;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-attachment: scroll; /* Adjusted to keep proportion accurate */
padding: 8rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.promise-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
gap: 3rem;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.promise-grid {
grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
}
}
.promise-tag {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-size: 2.75rem;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--accent-color);
line-height: 1.1;
}
.promise-text {
font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.45rem);
color: var(--text-primary);
font-weight: 400;
line-height: 1.8;
}
/* Services Section */
.services {
padding: 7rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.section-header {
margin-bottom: 4.5rem;
}
.section-header h2 {
font-size: 3rem;
margin-bottom: 1rem;
font-weight: 400;
}
.section-header p {
color: var(--text-secondary);
font-size: 1.05rem;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.services-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
gap: 1.5rem;
}
@media (min-width: 600px) {
.services-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
}
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
.services-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
}
}
.service-card {
border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding: 3rem 2.25rem;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
justify-content: space-between;
min-height: 270px;
transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
position: relative;
}
.service-card:hover {
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
transform: translateY(-5px);
box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
}
.service-card h3 {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-size: 1.65rem;
margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
font-weight: 400;
transition: color 0.3s ease;
}
.service-card:hover h3 {
color: var(--vivid-accent);
}
.service-card p {
color: var(--text-secondary);
font-size: 0.9rem;
line-height: 1.6;
}
/* Pricing Packages Section */
.pricing {
padding: 7rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.pricing-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
gap: 2rem;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.pricing-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
}
}
.pricing-card {
border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
justify-content: space-between;
min-height: 400px;
transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.pricing-card:hover {
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
transform: translateY(-5px);
box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
}
.pricing-card h3 {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: 2rem;
font-weight: 400;
margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.pricing-price {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-size: 2.5rem;
color: var(--accent-color);
margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
font-weight: 400;
transition: color 0.3s ease;
}
.pricing-card:hover .pricing-price {
color: var(--vivid-accent);
}
.pricing-price span {
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.85rem;
color: var(--text-secondary);
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.pricing-features {
list-style: none;
margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
.pricing-features li {
font-size: 0.85rem;
color: var(--text-secondary);
padding: 0.5rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
/* Mid-Page Graphic Backdrop Section */
.testimonial-backdrop {
position: relative;
background-image: linear-gradient(
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.75),
rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.85)
), url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563720223185-
11003d516935?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2400&q=95');
background-size: cover;
background-position: center;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-attachment: scroll; /* Parallax effect fallback */
padding: 10rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.testimonial-backdrop .review-text {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4.5vw, 2.75rem);
line-height: 1.3;
font-weight: 400;
max-width: 900px;
margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.testimonial-backdrop .review-author {
color: var(--vivid-accent);
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
font-size: 1rem;
}
/* Specialized Gallery Grid Configured with High-Resolution Google Maps Photo
Files */
.maps-gallery {
padding: 7rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.maps-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
gap: 1rem;
transition: all 0.5s ease-out;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.maps-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
}
}
.maps-card {
position: relative;
background-size: cover;
background-position: center;
background-color: var(--card-bg);
aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
cursor: pointer;
overflow: hidden;
display: flex;
align-items: flex-end;
padding: 1.5rem;
transition: border-color 0.4s ease;
}
.maps-card-desc {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: 1.1rem;
color: var(--text-secondary);
z-index: 2;
line-height: 1.3;
transition: color 0.3s ease;
}
.maps-card::before {
content: '';
position: absolute;
inset: 0;
background: linear-gradient(transparent 50%, rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.95));
z-index: 1;
}
.maps-card-number {
position: absolute;
top: 1.25rem;
right: 1.25rem;
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: 1.5rem;
color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4);
z-index: 2;
}
/* Glassmorphic View overlay for portfolio cards */
.maps-card::after {
content: 'VIEW PORTFOLIO';
position: absolute;
inset: 0;
background-color: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.4);
backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: 0.95rem;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
color: var(--vivid-accent);
opacity: 0;
z-index: 3;
transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.maps-card:hover {
border-color: var(--vivid-accent);
}
.maps-card:hover .maps-card-desc {
color: var(--text-primary);
}
.maps-card:hover::after {
opacity: 1;
}
/* Interactive Auto Detailing Calculator Section */
.calculator-section {
padding: 7rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.calculator-box {
background-color: var(--card-bg);
border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
gap: 3rem;
}
/* Switched breakpoint to 900px to keep input sliders roomy on portrait iPads */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
.calculator-box {
grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
}
}
.calc-inputs {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 2rem;
}
.calc-group {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 0.75rem;
}
.calc-group label {
font-size: 0.85rem;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
color: var(--text-secondary);
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
}
.calc-group label span {
color: var(--accent-color);
font-weight: 600;
}
/* Drag-friendly touch boundaries for tablet screens */
.range-slider {
-webkit-appearance: none;
width: 100%;
height: 4px;
background: var(--border-color);
outline: none;
padding: 10px 0; /* Expanded touch zone */
cursor: pointer;
}
.range-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
-webkit-appearance: none;
appearance: none;
width: 18px;
height: 18px;
border-radius: 50%;
background: var(--accent-color);
box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--vivid-accent);
transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
margin-top: -7px; /* Align precisely with the track */
}
.range-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
width: 100%;
height: 4px;
background: var(--border-color);
border: none;
}
.range-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover {
transform: scale(1.3);
background: var(--vivid-accent);
}
.calc-result-box {
border-left: none;
border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding-top: 2rem;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
text-align: center;
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
.calc-result-box {
border-left: 1px solid var(--border-color);
border-top: none;
padding-top: 0;
padding-left: 2rem;
}
}
.calc-result-title {
font-family: var(--font-body);
font-size: 0.8rem;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
color: var(--text-secondary);
margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.calc-result-payment {
font-family: var(--font-head);
font-style: italic;
font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
color: var(--vivid-accent);
text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4);
font-weight: 700;
line-height: 1.1;
margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.calc-result-notice {
font-size: 0.75rem;
color: var(--text-secondary);
max-width: 250px;
}
/* Remaining Testimonials & Info Split */
.testimonials-and-info {
padding: 7rem 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.split-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
gap: 5.5rem;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
.split-grid {
grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
}
}
.reviews-list {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 3rem;
}
.review-item {
border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
padding-top: 2rem;
transition: opacity 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,
1, 0.3, 1), transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.review-item:first-child {
border-top: none;
padding-top: 0;
}
.review-item p {
font-size: 1.25rem;
line-height: 1.7;
margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
}

color: var(--text-secondary);

/* Info Block Styling */

<!-- Interactive JavaScript Logic -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
/* --- TAB SYSTEM NAVIGATION LOGIC --- */
const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
const tabPanes = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane');
const switchTabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.switch-tab-btn');
function switchTab(targetTabId) {
// Remove active states from navigation
navLinks.forEach(link => {
if (link.getAttribute('data-target') === targetTabId) {
link.classList.add('active');
} else {
link.classList.remove('active');
}
});
// Toggle visibility of panes
tabPanes.forEach(pane => {
if (pane.id === targetTabId) {
pane.classList.add('active-pane');
// Instantly trigger reveal classes within active pane to prevent rendering
gaps
const activeReveals = pane.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
activeReveals.forEach(el => el.classList.add('active'));
} else {
pane.classList.remove('active-pane');
}
});
// Scroll back to top smoothly
window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
// Tab Click Listeners
navLinks.forEach(link => {
link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
const target = link.getAttribute('data-target');
switchTab(target);
});
});
// General CTA Toggling Buttons (e.g. from Hero or Pricing Cards to Book Tab)
switchTabButtons.forEach(btn => {
btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
const target = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
switchTab(target);
});
});
/* --- NATIVE SCROLL REVEAL LOGIC --- */
const observerOptions = {
root: null,
rootMargin: '0px 0px -5% 0px', // Adjusted safely to prevent rendering delays
on Safari iOS
threshold: 0.1
};
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
entries.forEach(entry => {
if (entry.isIntersecting) {
entry.target.classList.add('active');
observer.unobserve(entry.target);
}
});
}, observerOptions);
const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
revealElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
/* --- INTERACTIVE DETAILING CALCULATOR LOGIC --- */
const calcVehicle = document.getElementById('calc-vehicle');
const calcCondition = document.getElementById('calc-condition');
const calcAddon = document.getElementById('calc-addon');
const vehicleLbl = document.getElementById('vehicle-lbl');
const conditionLbl = document.getElementById('condition-lbl');
const addonLbl = document.getElementById('addon-lbl');
const paymentOutput = document.getElementById('payment-output');
function calculatePackage() {
const basePrice = parseFloat(calcVehicle.value);
const conditionSurcharge = parseFloat(calcCondition.value);
const addonSurcharge = parseFloat(calcAddon.value);
// Update Labels dynamically
vehicleLbl.innerText =
calcVehicle.options[calcVehicle.selectedIndex].text.split(' / ')[0].split(' ($')[0];
conditionLbl.innerText =
calcCondition.options[calcCondition.selectedIndex].text.split(' (')[0];
addonLbl.innerText = calcAddon.options[calcAddon.selectedIndex].text.split('
(+$')[0];
// Compute total package estimate
const packageTotal = basePrice + conditionSurcharge + addonSurcharge;
paymentOutput.innerText = `$${packageTotal}`;
}
// Dropdown Listeners
calcVehicle.addEventListener('change', calculatePackage);
calcCondition.addEventListener('change', calculatePackage);
calcAddon.addEventListener('change', calculatePackage);
// Initial computation
calculatePackage();
/* --- DYNAMIC GALLERY TABS FILTER LOGIC --- */
const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
const galleryCards = document.querySelectorAll('.maps-card');
tabButtons.forEach(button => {
button.addEventListener('click', () => {
// Toggle active button class
tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
button.classList.add('active');
const filterValue = button.getAttribute('data-filter');
galleryCards.forEach(card => {
const cardCategory = card.getAttribute('data-category');
if (filterValue === 'all' || cardCategory === filterValue) {
card.classList.remove('hide');
} else {
card.classList.add('hide');
}
});
});
